verdict.rationale: macOS's built-in Siri AI works on the user's own content inside the OS. It can provide feedback on what you've written, answer questions about anything on screen such as an image or PDF, and search your photos, emails, and notes. Automatic topic grouping of Safari tabs adds a further AI-organized suggestion layer. However, the docs never describe proactively generated insights or suggestions drawn from a user's broader data, and all evidence is vendor marketing with no hands-on or independent corroboration. Missing for 10: documented proactive insight or suggestion generation across personal data, depth and limits of data analysis, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can get AI-generated insights and suggestions from my data inside the product

citations.quote: Siri AI can now generate a draft from scratch or provide feedback on what you’ve written.
Just take a screenshot of what’s on your display, like an image or a PDF, to get answers, search, or take action.
Search for a photo from years ago, easily locate an email buried in your inbox, or pull up a note you saved on your Mac.
Now your tabs can be automatically grouped into topics, so related pages are easier to find on your Mac.
